The mark out of ten starts at 6.0 and moves with what he did — and his work off the ball is paid on the difference from what THE MEN OF HIS OWN LINE managed, not on the raw count: a forward recovers fewer balls and loses more of them than a centre-back because that is what the job is. recov is balls WON BACK — which is what the engine has always counted, and since engine phase 8 what the action in the feed is called too: a recovery rather than a tackle as football counts one, which is why a goalkeeper's figure is large — he picks up everything that runs into his box.
